temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with him over the past few days. When he asks, she says she is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly due to a misunderstanding or an unknowing mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: her curtness is not due to anger at him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is under personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be understanding and consider offering support if appropriate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers Elizabeth someone to talk to and suggests a coffee break. Elizabeth accepts and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is not upset with him but is dealing with personal stress; she may need support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed/strengthened: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and willing to take a coffee break with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is open to his support, and a coffee break may help; he can support her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Listen to her and provide support during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the coffee break, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. She says she has thought about professional help but is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is open to his support; he does not yet know how severe it is or how she views professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: he learns her stress is severe and believes professional help might benefit her; after he suggests it, he learns she is hesitant/unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth has severe stress; professional help might benefit her, but she is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Respect her hesitation and continue supporting her without pushing professional help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the professional-help suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn. She tells him he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth has severe stress; professional help might benefit her, but she is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: First changed: her withdrawal makes him think his suggestion may have embarrassed her. Then corrected: she says he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth was not offended; she appreciates his concern, but she is still processing the idea and has a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful/worried after interpreting withdrawal as embarrassment; then relieved but still concerned after her reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure her that he did not mean to overstep and continue offering support without pressure.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative. She thanks Keith, says his support means a lot, and feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is still processing; he hopes she values his support and feels comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed/strengthened: Elizabeth values his support, is grateful, and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing he is there; she is more comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks together.
